study: RSI-2 'red' as an exit: sell the desk's open trade at the next SIP open after a completed 1-minute IEX bar with RSI-2 > 90, if that comes before the desk's own exit. Operator 2026-10-14 ('can we determine when we are going to hit red in RSI?').
registered_at: 2026-10-14 ~15:00 ET, before any return of this rule was computed.
prior: LOW-to-mixed. Exits move win rate, not the mean (exits-cannot-move-the-mean, 42 shapes ~0 gross); holding longer loses more on this book, so ANY earlier exit tends to help - hence the random-early-exit control. RSI-2 > 95 as an entry filter was noise (10/2). Red as an exit was never tested.
data: Desk trades (outcomes.jsonl, entry_path 'watch') on the 26 cached sessions 2026-09-08..10-13; IEX 1-minute bars with the prior-session warm-up added for connors_green_prereg.json (--fetch-prior, days with > 5% of board names lacking it excluded and listed); SIP bars for prices.
rule: RSI-2 = Wilder alpha 1/2 on raw IEX closes with the last 220 prior-session bars prepended (early_entry_honest.rsi2_series, = live cm_rsi_series). First completed bar m with m >= the entry minute and m <= desk exit minute - 2 and RSI-2 > 90 -> exit at the SIP open of m+1. Otherwise the trade keeps the desk's exit.
pricing: Base = the desk's real exit fill (outcomes exit_price). Red and control exits = SIP open of the exit minute less HALF the full SIP quoted spread at that time (replay_costing.entry_spread_bp, fetched after the close; a sell fills at the bid). No-NBBO exits are counted and priced at the SIP open.
control: Hazard-matched random exit (primary): red's pooled fire rate per eligible bar p (fires / eligible bars, a count) is computed first; each eligible trade then exits at m+1 with probability p at each eligible bar (seed sha256(symbol|day|entry_minute|RED_HAZARD|early-honest-v1)). Uniform-over-the-hold control dropped (it lands later than red by construction).
pass: Each half: mean over ALL eligible trades of (red exit - hazard exit) / desk fill >= +2 bp with day-clustered t >= 2.0, AND red vs the desk fill > 0 per eligible trade, AND >= 60 red fires on >= 6 days. PASS only if both halves pass; FAIL if either fails; else UNDERPOWERED.
information_only: sell one minute later (m+2, live latency)
red only from the bar after the entry bar (and the share of fires on the entry bar)
panel-strict red (also close < SMA200 and > SMA5)
multiplicity: 1 exit rule (variants above as information) on trades already used by 42 exit-shape tests. Prior live evidence on a related exit: ai_exit_left_overbought (the %R left-overbought triangle) is on, 89 of these exits; config.py calls it 'the small-loss factory'.
if_pass: Forward confirmation on >= 10 sessions after 2026-10-14 (the desk's own trades), then a result-skeptic review, before any exit change.
if_fail: RSI-2 red is closed as an exit on completed 1-minute bars.
eligibility: Trades with desk exit minute - entry minute >= 2 (red can fire at all); shorter holds, missing bars or exit price are skipped and counted by reason, as are traded names without prior-session bars.
amended: 2026-10-14 before any score, after result-skeptic round 1 FIX FIRST: hazard-matched control, base = real fill, half-spread on simulated exits, m+2 and entry-bar information rows, eligibility and skip counts, LOB prior named, bar per eligible trade +2 bp.
